title: An open covering of a quasi-compact space is refined by opens whose closures lie in the members
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that an open covering of a quasi-compact Hausdorff space can be refined by open subsets whose closures lie inside the members of the covering (author lemma at source lines 2301-2307, label lemma-relatively-compact-refinement). The proof (source lines 2309-2320) separates each point from the closed complement of a covering member, takes the closure of the resulting neighbourhood, extracts a finite subcover by quasi-compactness and regroups the neighbourhoods by the member they refine (proof lines 2309-2319). The pointwise separation and the regrouping are the substance. H3.
